exemptions.surface: origin attestation — the credential authority's signing operation
exemptions.why_manifest_bound_state_transition_is_n: org-boundary/runtime/origin_attestation.py reaches PROVEN only by calling TV_EXPORT_HMAC_SIGN and TV_EXPORT_HMAC_VERIFY on a TV/TVC resident host, whose key is loaded from a systemd credential directory. The attestation action is therefore performable only where that host answers, which is the prohibited justification AN_EXTERNAL_MACHINE_MUST_BE_RUNNING. Recording that as a ceiling in the overlay stated it honestly but left it outside the register; it is registered here so it is not cited as a reason.
exemptions.required_evidence_or_repair: The credential authority exposes attestation as a manifest-bound state transition — a signing request that crosses as a governed manifest and returns a receipt — rather than as a resident-host call. The repair is to make attestation manifest-bound, NOT to stand up a machine for this organization to await; standing one up would satisfy the call and still fail the standard. This is StegVerse-Labs/tvc's declaration to make, per AUTHORITY_SOURCE in org-boundary/runtime/origin_attestation.py, which names StegVerse-Labs/tvc:scripts/tv_credential_verify_export_resident.py.
exemptions._why_the_disposition_is_ALLOW: An emission with no authority supplied completes and records origin_attestation_state NOT_PROVEN with signer_supplied false. Nothing is awaited and no absence becomes a transition, so the crossing itself conforms. What does not conform is that the attestation action cannot be reached here at all, and that is what this entry registers. An offered attestation that fails refuses the emission, which is the non-ALLOW path.
